mapper.select: SELECT sc.*, co.cname AS commodityName, co.cprice AS commodityPrice, co.cnum AS commodityNum, i.ipath AS imagePath FROM shopcart sc LEFT JOIN commodity co ON sc.commodityid = co.id LEFT JOIN image i ON co.id = i.commodityid WHERE sc.userid = #{userid} AND sc.confirm = 0 ORDER BY sc.createtime DESC

SELECT sc.*, co.cname AS commodityName, co.cprice AS commodityPrice, i.ipath AS imagePath, o.orderno AS orderNo FROM shopcart sc LEFT JOIN commodity co ON sc.commodityid = co.id LEFT JOIN image i ON co.id = i.commodityid LEFT JOIN `order` o ON sc.orderid = o.id WHERE sc.userid = #{userid} AND sc.confirm = 1 ORDER BY sc.createtime DESC
SELECT * FROM shopcart WHERE userid = #{userid} AND commodityid = #{commodityid} AND confirm = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopcart (userid, commodityid, cnum, confirm) VALUES (#{userid}, #{commodityid}, #{cnum}, #{confirm})
mapper.update: UPDATE shopcart SET cnum = #{cnum} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE shopcart SET confirm = 1, orderid = #{orderid} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sc.cnum * co.cprice), 0) FROM shopcart sc INNER JOIN commodity co ON sc.commodityid = co.id WHERE co.supplierid = #{supplierid} AND sc.confirm = 1
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sc.cnum), 0) FROM shopcart sc INNER JOIN commodity co ON sc.commodityid = co.id WHERE co.supplierid = #{supplierid} AND sc.confirm = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.orderid) FROM shopcart sc INNER JOIN commodity co ON sc.commodityid = co.id WHERE co.supplierid = #{supplierid} AND sc.confirm = 1 AND sc.orderid IS NOT NULL
